newsitem.title: UK: Incepta sets terms for Citigate merger.
newsitem.headline: Incepta sets terms for Citigate merger.

text.p: British marketing and publishing firm Incepta Plc said on Friday it had settled terms for a proposed acquisition of public relations and advertising agency Citigate Communications and would be launching a bid and share placing to acquire all of Citigate's shares.

Under the terms of the offer Incepta will be offering new shares in exchange for Citigate's shares, and in order to back the deal it will make a share issue raising a combined 8.32 million stg -- 3.0 million stg for itself and 5.32 million stg to pay certain Citigate shareholders.
An extraordinary meeting is planned for February 27 to approve the deal ahead of a relisting of Incepta's shares on March 3, the company said in a statement.
